name: Gol Ghar — Kabini River Lodge (Jungle Lodges)
signature_dish: River-facing buffet with Indian home-style dishes
why_it_matters: The Gol Ghar at Kabini River Lodge — the Karnataka government's Jungle Lodges and Resorts property on a 54-acre site on the banks of the Kabini, once the Maharaja of Mysore's hunting retreat. Meals are served buffet-style in the river-facing open-air gazebo; reviewers describe wholesale, home-cooked Indian food with a wide veg and non-veg spread. The original and most-cited wildlife-lodge dining on the Kabini.
insider_tip: Buffet only, served at set times tied to the safari schedule; non-resident dining must be booked in advance. This is the more affordable JLR option versus the luxury Kabini resorts. Cards, UPI and cash at reception.
signature_address: Kabini River Lodge, Nissana Beltur Post, Karapura, H D Kote Taluk, Mysuru District, Karnataka 571114

name: Honey Comb — Evolve Back Kabini
signature_dish: River-view buffet plus Kuruba Grill kebabs
why_it_matters: The dining at Evolve Back Kabini (formerly Orange County Kabini), one of the Kabini's flagship luxury resorts — the Honey Comb restaurant serves international and regional cuisine overlooking the river, the Kuruba Grill is a kebab-and-grill specialty restaurant, and the resort also runs a one-of-a-kind boat-dining experience on the Kabini.
insider_tip: This is a luxury resort — non-resident dining needs advance arrangement and is expensive. The Kuruba Grill requires pre-booking as the kitchen prepares everything fresh. Best as part of an Evolve Back stay. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: Evolve Back Kabini, Beeramballi village, H D Kote Taluk, Mysuru District, Karnataka 571114

name: Wildgrass — The Serai Kabini
area: The Serai Kabini, Kabini river, near Nagarhole
why_it_matters: Wildgrass, the restaurant of The Serai Kabini — a luxury riverside resort of 20 residences near Nagarhole. The restaurant serves Indian, Western and Chinese cuisine, with the bamboo-shaded bar The Outpost alongside. Reviewers single out the Kabini mutton and praise the fresh, thoughtfully prepared meals.
insider_tip: Luxury resort dining — non-resident meals need to be arranged ahead and are expensive. Ask for the Kabini mutton if you eat non-veg. Best taken as part of a Serai stay. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: The Serai Kabini, near Nagarhole National Park, H D Kote Taluk, Mysuru District, Karnataka 571114

name: The Dining Deck — Waterwoods Lodge Kabini
signature_dish: Garden-to-table buffet with Kabini river fish
why_it_matters: The Dining Deck at Waterwoods Lodge — established in 1999 as the first private lodge at Nagarhole, on the Kabini backwaters at N. Begur. The kitchen is genuinely garden-to-table: about two-thirds of the fruit, vegetables and herbs come from the lodge's own organic garden, and the menu includes river fish sustainably sourced from the Kabini. A homely buffet plus a bonfire barbecue option.
insider_tip: More homely and intimate than the big luxury resorts. Buffet served by the river; the bonfire barbecue dinner is the standout. Non-resident dining should be arranged ahead. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: Waterwoods Lodge Kabini, N. Begur, Kabini backwaters, H D Kote Taluk, Mysuru District, Karnataka 571114
